title: Fullbright No Shading
description: A clean client-side fullbright and no-shading mod for brighter, sharper Minecraft visuals.
body:
# Fullbright No Shading

Fullbright No Shading is a lightweight client-side Fabric mod that makes Minecraft visuals brighter, cleaner, and easier to read.

It combines powerful fullbright controls with no-shading options inspired by clean visual enhancement mods, giving caves, villages, entities, items, blocks, fluids, and clouds a sharper and more consistent look.

## Features

- Toggleable fullbright
- Fullbright strength slider up to 1200%
- Increase/decrease brightness with keybinds
- Open config GUI with a keybind
- Cloth Config GUI support
- Mod Menu integration
- No Block Shading option
- No Cloud Shading option
- No Entity Shading option
- Saves settings automatically
- Client-side only

## FPS / Performance

This mod can help FPS slightly in some cases because no-shading options reduce some visual lighting/shading work, especially for block, cloud, and entity rendering.

It is not a full performance mod like Sodium, but it is lightweight and should not noticeably reduce FPS. For most players, it should feel neutral or slightly better while making the game look much clearer.

## Recommended With

- Sodium
- Mod Menu
- Cloth Config API
